notes.title: Patch 0.9.1
notes.notes:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30852967/21e068a0c95906149f64f54c5625fe0a27a26e9b.png

Very soon we will present the first version of AZURA. The game is the only one available in English, Russian and Ukrainian but we are working on the translations! Now we are looking for people who can help us with translation to other languages. Please contact us if you want to help with the translation.

In version 0.9.1 will be presented a full version of the game with the main storyline.
We really hope for feedback from you. All your reviews will be read. Messages about bugs, mistakes in translation, suggestions about gameplay are needed to make game better. We are new developers and your opinion is very important.
